question: Fill in the blank (2) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**optimal**" means the best or most effective, especially under particular conditions. (श्रेष्ठतम)
 
• It refers to providing the best conditions for growth and well-being.
 
• The other options: "**adequate**," "**special**," and "**robust**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is ''**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Such a diet not only provides the necessary nutrients for optimal__ growth and overall well-being but also reduces the risk of chronic conditions such as heart disease and diabetes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Adequate (पर्याप्त)**: means satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity.
 
• **Special (विशेष)**: means better, greater, or otherwise different from what is usual.
 
• **Robust (मज़बूत)**: means strong and healthy; vigorous.
